deviations.what: The Slider's `liveChange` attribute is dropped (the expression binding needs no event). **e2e-verified 2026-08-01** (scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs interaction, transpiled backend + real browser): one keyboard step on the Slider moves the Panel width to 99% with no round-trip - the expression binding replaces onSliderMoved completely. Residual: which GridList breakpoint the resized panel then hits (a visual property).

GridResponsiveLayout.layoutChange is wired to a client-composed MessageToast (control_global MESSAGE_TOAST, template 'Layout changed to {0}' filled by ${$parameters>/layout}) reproducing onLayoutChange 1:1 without a backend round-trip. The layoutChange attribute itself is kept, so structural-diff sees no difference.
